steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Mr. Czarny, there're too many calls coming from the various departments, we can't handle them all!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Just think of something. Try to make those still sane understand that 'victory' and 'value' are not equal.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: O-okay!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: ...Sir 'Left-hand', do you really not require further medical examination?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: No. Being able to knock me unconscious right when I was casting my Arts is already the limit of her ability. She's still far from being able to seriously injure me.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Pardon my bluntness, but the results of this match were a shock to many.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Even without an insignificant victory in this match, I will still bring the entirety of the Blade Helmet Knightclub into the Major with me. Worry not, spokesman.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: You're very confident, good.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: If you had gone all out, Maria Nearl would have stood no chance of victory. I hope that you will be able to deal with the fallout of this unexpected loss...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: I will not make excuses for myself.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: You may end up losing opportunities from some major sponsors. Perhaps your Knightclub can——

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: ——If those people are only able to see the most superficial wins and losses and cannot understand how to manage their interests, then they are not fit to work with me.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Hype is the basis of profit. The customers have only ever cared about what they can see. In other words, they are only trying to get some sensory stimulation... without being aware of it themselves.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: However, I never expected that Sir Tytus Topola himself would place such a clear price on his own 'failure'...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Spokesman, do not attempt to provoke me.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Yes, yes, my apologies......We will leave as soon as we are done handling all those troublesome matters.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Let us meet again at the Major, Sir 'Left-hand'.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: So that's it... Sona and them were doing such things...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The Infected fighters' arena. I'd heard of this competition format... No, this cannot even be considered a 'format'.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Whether or not they come from a knight family, anyone can become a competition knight, earn the recognition of the Knights Association through their grit and become a noble...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But the Infected...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: They'll let the Infected join the competitions, but there's no country that would let an Infected become a pillar of society. That's why they're segregated in another competition format.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: The Infected can earn money and live on, but they'll forever be simple gladiators trying to entertain the masses... Tch. There ain't any meaning to such a sideshow.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Oh, I don't mean anything by that.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: You old geezer, can't you be more tactful with your words?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Who in hell am I supposed to be tactful for, huh? They're almost onto us!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The Infected matter is worrying, but... now is not the time to be worrying about them.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: They changed their fate as Infected through their own tenacity... But they've saved many people.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: If we want to change anything, we will have to continue moving forward.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...Little Maria has become a respectable knight capable of such words... If only Margaret could see this, surely she would be gratified...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Don't speak of the Radiant Knight like she's dead, you idiot!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You're the one twisting my words, Kowal!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria? What's wrong?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: N-Nothing!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The Champion's Wall... What a lousy place for conversation.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...Pictures of all the old champions, huh. This Black Knight alone has three spots.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Even though she dominated the Major for so many years, she doesn't seem to have aged a day... Eh, why do I feel like she looks younger than me...?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Miss must be kidding.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Is that just good genes? How nice. How enviable.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: The Black Knight surely left an impressive mark on the history of knight sports. No one could have ever guessed that a Leithanian completely incapable of using Arts would ever become the 'Black Knight' we know today.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Her era is long gone, however... She herself has left Kazimierz.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I wouldn't expect you to let go of a cash cow like that.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: ...A dominating champion would indeed invite many worshippers, but it is very much a detriment to the development of the industry as a whole, in the long run...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: In short, it's exciting to see new challengers attempting to defeat the Black Knight, but after she managed to hold her own for three entire seasons... It started to get boring.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: The Black Knight's prospects near the end of her career weren't very good. The number of people who wanted to get rid of her one way or another could fill an entire arena.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Her luck was pretty good, though. Just as she was being cornered, she met a VIP from Kjerag.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: She got a reasonable price... that satisfied everyone.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Being able to support a good turnover is also a sign of a well-developed industry.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...And then there's this, an empty space.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The Radiant Knight?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Yes. I don't think I need to elaborate.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I know this one. From last season, the Blood Knight.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: The Blood Knight's terror and might are unprecedented in the arena. Thankfully, he's rather astute and hasn't caused much trouble for us.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You should tell him to take it easy on the drugs from time to time. Knights are the most important assets, right?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I will take that to heart, Miss.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...Well? I don't suppose the spokesman of the General Chamber of Commerce invited me here for a history lesson?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Sorry to trouble you. The Champion's Wall will be open to the public during the Major, so I have to do a check beforehand.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Of course, this is also one of the few places where I can speak without interruption.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hm... Alright. It's about another job, isn't it? I can't get away anyway, so I might as well listen.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: It's not just about a job... I wonder if you know what the two Lazurites are doing today?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You're not cleared to know. And neither am I.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I've heard some interesting rumors on the grapevine...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: What sort of major incident could've happened, that would need both Lazurites moving out in force?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ——Ahh la la, I didn't hear anything. Nothing at all.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Miss.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I've checked all the requests from the other directors. There isn't a single 'major incident' that would require a Lazurite, let alone both of them.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You don't have worry about that. Just know it's an order from the General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Is that so...? I can rest assured then.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...You really don't trust me, huh.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Why do you say so, Miss?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You know very well that asking me stuff about my bosses is a waste of time. Are you trying to give a warning to this 'immature Platinum'? Alright, alright, message received.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: You're very smart. However, my suspicions are also very valid. Even if the upper echelons are hiding things from me, I must perform my duties to perfection.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Yes. If you can, please instruct a subordinate of yours to help keep track of someone.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Who?
Czarny glances at the empty spot on the wall next to him.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Młynar Nearl.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Even though I think that he'll remain a useless piece of trash till the end, we must ensure that he does not affect our future plans.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: As for you, Miss, you must personally ensure that this carries on smoothly——

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ouch——! P-please be more gentle...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Bear with it! This ointment is really expensive!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It's my fault for not teaching you this. Being able to properly manage your injuries during a competition is also important. Lift up your hair.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Actually, I didn't expect that it would——Ah, ouch!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Going up against Ingra and then Topola, you should count your lucky stars that all four limbs are intact and you haven't suffered any major injuries...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Alright, put your clothes on.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Don't move for a few days and just stay still. Ending up with a stubborn old wound is one of the worst dangers of being a knight. Don't be like me.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Thank you, Auntie... err Zofia.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria, that combat style... How did you come up with it?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Rather than a combat style... Err, I was forced into it, actually...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: At the time, my only thoughts were 'Just hold on. There must be something I can do'——

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ouch!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Don't put yourself through hell for such a stupid reason! The accumulated fatigue will just make your next battles harder!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Sorry!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: *Sigh*... Luckily you were able to take advantage of the carelessness of that 'Left-hand.' If that sadistic pervert didn't underestimate you... then you'd be in trouble.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eh, have you fought him before?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: His first match after officially joining the Blade Helmet Knightclub was against me.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: O-Oh...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...What happened?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That's why he refuses to talk to anyone about his debut battle.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It's all in the past, though... There is always a winner and loser in knight sports... He doesn't care about me.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Mr. Tytus seemed to recognize Margaret.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Yep. The three members of Blade Helmet Knightclub, including him, tried to encircle Margaret during the melee, but ended up getting annihilated instead. Who would accept such an outrageous thing?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I-Is Margaret so merciless?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Margaret was very young back then.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...What was she thinking?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I remember that she hated knight sports more than anything, right? There was a time when I even thought that she was just like Uncle Młynar...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But in the end, she still went and became a competition knight, and even became the Radiant Knight...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...I don't know what she was thinking either. But she should be more aware than most what the knight sports represent.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Even so, she still went, and climbed to the peak.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: At the very least, there were quite a few people who fervently admired Margaret and were inspired by her to become knights, including me.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ehehe...To be honest, that was part of the reason for me too...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Who knows, maybe the reason she became the champion was to get a few more Zofias and Marias.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Is that it?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I don't know either.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I wonder if she's living well, at that Rhodes Island place...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ahh—!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Wh-What? Don't surprise me like that...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Th-There's a notch on my blade...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Ugh... You haven't been able to properly maintain your weapons, so it's not surprising that it ended up like this.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Can you deal with it yourself?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: *Sigh* Maybe, if I could borrow Master Kowal's workshop...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: What's up, V? Focus on driving. Don't make me get out and call a taxi.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I'm just thinking about those two squirrels... If you get out now I swear I'll run you over.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: ...Those Infected, huh.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: That day we almost got into a fight. Those people outside... could they have been?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Most likely.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Have they set their sights on Maria as well? Why?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: ...You're overthinking it.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Is it gonna rain the day after tomorrow?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Cloudy.
